settings.description: About the programmes, payment and how the work goes.

settings.text: Something else on your mind? Write to me, I read every message.

settings.question: Who are the programmes for?
settings.answer: Designers, makers, architects, photographers and small studio owners who sell their own work or time. Most clients have been in business for at least a year and are busy but not earning what they should.

settings.question: How much time does Studio Foundations take?
settings.answer: About three hours a week: the Tuesday call, one short lesson and one piece of homework you do on your own business. Calls are recorded if you miss one.

settings.question: What if I am not ready for a programme?
settings.answer: Start with the free worksheet and the show. Price It Right is a good next step: it takes an afternoon and you keep it for good.

settings.question: Can I pay in instalments?
settings.answer: Yes. Studio Foundations and mentoring can be paid in three monthly parts at checkout, with no extra cost.

settings.question: What if it is not working for me?
settings.answer: Tell me within the first two weeks of any programme and I refund you in full. For Price It Right, within 30 days.

settings.question: Do you work with teams?
settings.answer: Yes, for studios of up to ten people. Write to me with what is going on and I will suggest the best way in.

settings.heading: Not sure where to start?
settings.text: Three good first steps, depending on how much time you have this week.
